record.bible_text: Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068> unto me, Though Moses<WH04872> and Samuel<WH08050> stood<WH05975><WTH8799> before<WH06440> me, <FI>yet<Fi> my mind<WH05315> <FI>could<Fi> not <FI>be<Fi> toward this people<WH05971>: cast <FI>them<Fi>  out<WH07971><WTH8761> of my sight<WH06440>, and let them go forth<WH03318><WTH8799>.

And it shall come to pass, if they say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto thee, Whither shall we go forth<WH03318><WTH8799>? then thou shalt tell<WH0559><WTH8804> them, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Such as <FI>are<Fi> for death<WH04194>, to death<WH04194>; and such as <FI>are<Fi> for the sword<WH02719>, to the sword<WH02719>; and such as <FI>are<Fi> for the famine<WH07458>, to the famine<WH07458>; and such as <FI>are<Fi> for the captivity<WH07628>, to the captivity<WH07628>.

And I will cause<WH05414><WTH8804> them to be removed<WH02189><WTH8675><WH02113> into all kingdoms<WH04467> of the earth<WH0776>, because<WH01558> of Manasseh<WH04519> the son<WH01121> of Hezekiah<WH03169> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, for <FI> that<Fi> which he did<WH06213><WTH8804> in Jerusalem<WH03389>. <RF>cause...: Heb. give them for a removing<Rf>

For who shall have pity<WH02550><WTH8799> upon thee, O Jerusalem<WH03389>? or who shall bemoan<WH05110><WTH8799> thee? or who shall go aside<WH05493><WTH8799> to ask<WH07592><WTH8800> how thou doest<WH07965>? <RF>how...: Heb. of thy peace?<Rf>

Thou hast forsaken<WH05203><WTH8804> me, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, thou art gone<WH03212><WTH8799> backward<WH0268>: therefore will I stretch out<WH05186><WTH8686> my hand<WH03027> against thee, and destroy<WH07843><WTH8686> thee; I am weary<WH03811><WTH8738> with repenting<WH05162><WTH8736>.

And I will fan<WH02219><WTH8799> them with a fan<WH04214> in the gates<WH08179> of the land<WH0776>; I will bereave<WH07921><WTH8765> <FI>them<Fi> of children, I will destroy<WH06><WTH8765> my people<WH05971>, <FI>since<Fi> they return<WH07725><WTH8804> not from their ways<WH01870>. <RF>children: or, whatsoever is dear<Rf>

Their widows<WH0490> are increased<WH06105><WTH8804> to me above the sand<WH02344> of the seas<WH03220>: I have brought<WH0935><WTH8689> upon them against the mother<WH0517> of the young men<WH0970> a spoiler<WH07703><WTH8802> at noonday<WH06672>: I have caused <FI>him<Fi> to fall<WH05307><WTH8689> upon it suddenly<WH06597>, and terrors<WH0928> upon the city<WH05892>. <RF>the mother...: or, the mother city a young man spoiling, etc, or, the mother and the young men<Rf>

She that hath borne<WH03205><WTH8802> seven<WH07651> languisheth<WH0535><WTH8797>: she hath given up<WH05301><WTH8804> the ghost<WH05315>; her sun<WH08121> is gone<WH0935><WTH8804> down while <FI>it was<Fi>  yet day<WH03119><WTH8676><WH03117>: she hath been ashamed<WH0954><WTH8804> and confounded<WH02659><WTH8804>: and the residue<WH07611> of them will I deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> to the sword<WH02719> before<WH06440> their enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

Woe<WH0188> is me, my mother<WH0517>, that thou hast borne<WH03205><WTH8804> me a man<WH0376> of strife<WH07379> and a man<WH0376> of contention<WH04066> to the whole earth<WH0776>! I have neither lent on usury<WH05383><WTH8804>, nor men have lent to me on usury<WH05383><WTH8804>; <FI>yet<Fi> every one of them doth curse<WH07043><WTH8764> me.

The LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Verily<WH03808><WH0518> it shall be well<WH02896> with thy remnant<WH08281><WTH8765><WTH8675><WH08293>; verily<WH0518> I will cause the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> to entreat<WH06293><WTH8689> thee <FI>well<Fi> in the time<WH06256> of evil<WH07451> and in the time<WH06256> of affliction<WH06869>. <RF>cause...: or, intreat the enemy for thee<Rf>
Shall iron<WH01270> break<WH07489><WTH8799> the northern<WH06828> iron<WH01270> and the steel<WH05178>?

Thy substance<WH02428> and thy treasures<WH0214> will I give<WH05414><WTH8799> to the spoil<WH0957> without price<WH04242>, and <FI>that<Fi> for all thy sins<WH02403>, even in all thy borders<WH01366>.

And I will make <FI>thee<Fi> to pass<WH05674><WTH8689> with thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> into a land<WH0776> <FI>which<Fi> thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> not: for a fire<WH0784> is kindled<WH06919><WTH8804> in mine anger<WH0639>, <FI>which<Fi> shall burn<WH03344><WTH8714> upon you.<CM>

O LORD<WH03068>, thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804>: remember<WH02142><WTH8798> me, and visit<WH06485><WTH8798> me, and revenge<WH05358><WTH8734> me of my persecutors<WH07291><WTH8802>; take me not away<WH03947><WTH8799> in thy longsuffering<WH0639><WH0750>: know<WH03045><WTH8798> that for thy sake I have suffered<WH05375><WTH8800> rebuke<WH02781>.

Thy words<WH01697> were found<WH04672><WTH8738>, and I did eat<WH0398><WTH8799> them; and thy word<WH01697> was unto me the joy<WH08342> and rejoicing<WH08057> of mine heart<WH03824>: for I am called<WH07121><WTH8738> by thy name<WH08034>, O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>. <RF>I am...: Heb. thy name is called upon me<Rf>

I sat<WH03427><WTH8804> not in the assembly<WH05475> of the mockers<WH07832><WTH8764>, nor rejoiced<WH05937><WTH8799>; I sat<WH03427><WTH8804> alone<WH0910> because<WH06440> of thy hand<WH03027>: for thou hast filled<WH04390><WTH8765> me with indignation<WH02195>.

Why is my pain<WH03511> perpetual<WH05331>, and my wound<WH04347> incurable<WH0605><WTH8803>, <FI>which<Fi> refuseth<WH03985><WTH8765> to be healed<WH07495><WTH8736>? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar<WH0391>, <FI>and as<Fi> waters<WH04325> <FI>that<Fi> fail<WH0539><WTH8738>? <RF>fail: Heb. be not sure?<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, If thou return<WH07725><WTH8799>, then will I bring thee again<WH07725><WTH8686>, <FI>and<Fi> thou shalt stand<WH05975><WTH8799> before<WH06440> me: and if thou take forth<WH03318><WTH8686> the precious<WH03368> from the vile<WH02151><WTH8802>, thou shalt be as my mouth<WH06310>: let them return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto thee; but return<WH07725><WTH8799> not thou unto them.

And I will make<WH05414><WTH8804> thee unto this people<WH05971> a fenced<WH01219><WTH8803> brasen<WH05178> wall<WH02346>: and they shall fight<WH03898><WTH8738> against thee, but they shall not prevail<WH03201><WTH8799> against thee: for I <FI>am<Fi>  with thee to save<WH03467><WTH8687> thee and to deliver<WH05337><WTH8687> thee, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.
And I will deliver<WH05337><WTH8689> thee out of the hand<WH03027> of the wicked<WH07451>, and I will redeem<WH06299><WTH8804> thee out of the hand<WH03709> of the terrible<WH06184>.<CM>
